Specification: This specification models a trivial initial-state-only system over two variables x and y. The state predicate requires both variables to be 0 and also equal, and the temporal formula then constrains all behavior to be stuttering steps that leave x and y unchanged forever. There is no fault model, no next-state transition relation beyond stuttering, and no explicit safety or liveness theorem beyond the single temporal specification.
